captions.detailed: A Mexican mission-style bell wall tower consisting of a tan-colored curved masonry arch wall sitting on a dark brown rectangular base. Inside the arched opening, a golden-brown bell hangs from a dark brown wooden headstock. The bell is connected via a revolute joint, allowing it to swing back and forth relative to the static arch tower.
captions.instruction: Generate a Mexican mission-style bell wall tower with a tan curved masonry arch wall and a dark brown base. Inside the arch opening, mount a golden-brown bell on a dark brown wooden headstock using a revolute joint so that the bell can swing.
captions.factory: The code constructs a static base and a main wall using a combination of Box and Cylinder primitives, subtracting an inner arched opening using boolean operations. The bell is modeled as a separate part using a revolved profile or a combination of cylinders and cones, attached to a horizontal headstock box. A revolute articulation is defined along the Y-axis to connect the bell assembly to the static arched wall.
